creativeBrief: Instrumental, atmospheric and deeply emotional deep house, around 120 BPM, for late-night listening or an after-hours set. Bittersweet, yearning and enveloping — melancholic but still body-led and hypnotic, never sleepy. Groove: a soft, warm four-on-the-floor kick with gentle swing, airy shuffled hats, a quiet shaker and a distant, mellow clap; percussion stays light so the atmosphere breathes. Bass: a warm, rounded sub-bass that answers the kick with long, sighing notes and small syncopations, leaving space on the downbeats. Harmony: slow, wide minor-key chords with soulful, slightly jazzy extensions — lush evolving analog pads, a tender Rhodes-style electric piano motif repeated with small variations, and a faint high string-like texture. One coherent, dusty, warm sound identity with subtle tape saturation and natural depth, not a reverb wash. Structure (about 2 minutes): pad-and-texture intro with a filtered kick; groove and bass enter; the chords open up and the motif develops; an emotional breakdown where the kick drops, the pad swells and the piano motif stands almost alone; a slow filter build back into the full groove with one extra percussion layer and the warmest chord voicing; a gentle filtered outro. Avoid festival EDM drops, big risers, tropical house plucks, bright supersaw leads, busy melodies and excessive reverb.
